_about: California income tax paid on company wealth by the four largest California fortunes, 2019-2025, nominal $ millions, as estimated by Boll, Saez and Zucman from SEC disclosures of stock sales, donations and option exercises, plus Compustat dividends and executive compensation. Company wealth is 97% of their Forbes wealth at the end of 2025. The model uses the 2023-2025 average.
source: Boll, Saez and Zucman (2026), NBER Working Paper 35218 (revised August 2026), Table 3

cohort._about: Same paper, Table 2: estimated California income tax paid by all California billionaires, nominal $ billions.
